implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindromes in a given text file
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py reads the file (read_file) and calls find_palindromic_words(text) and find_palindromic_lines(text.splitlines(keepends=True)) to locate palindromic words and lines, then prints the results.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Read a text file supplied via command‑line argument
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py uses argparse to accept a file path and read_file() opens the file with UTF‑8 encoding, exiting on error.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Normalize text (ignore case, spaces, punctuation) for palindrome checking
implemented_requirements.evidence: palindrome.py defines normalize(text) that lower‑cases and keeps only alphanumeric characters; is_palindrome() uses this function.
find_palindromic_words(text) iterates over text.split(), normalizes each word, checks is_palindrome, and returns a list of unique palindromic words.
find_palindromic_lines(lines) enumerates the supplied lines and returns those where is_palindrome(line) is true.

judge.summary: The submitted code provides a complete, runnable program that reads a text file, detects both palindromic words and whole lines (ignoring case, spaces, and punctuation), and reports the findings. All core functionality is implemented with clear, testable code, and there are no evident blockers to execution.
